name: Phyllotaxis
description: One sunflower head across the whole sheet: seeds set at the golden angle in interlocking spirals, ringed by petals.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { -webkit-transform: translate(@calc(100 * (@X / 2 + 0.42 * min(@X, @Y) / sqrt(@I) * sqrt(@i - 0.5) * cos(@i * 2.399963) - @x + 0.5))%, @calc(100 * (@Y / 2 + 0.42 * min(@X, @Y) / sqrt(@I) * sqrt(@i - 0.5) * sin(@i * 2.399963) - @y + 0.5))%) rotate(@calc(@i * 137.5078)deg) scale(@calc(0.42 * min(@X, @Y) / sqrt(@I) * 2.6 * (0.8 + 0.4 * sqrt(@i / @I)))); transform: translate(@calc(100 * (@X / 2 + 0.42 * min(@X, @Y) / sqrt(@I) * sqrt(@i - 0.5) * cos(@i * 2.399963) - @x + 0.5))%, @calc(100 * (@Y / 2 + 0.42 * min(@X, @Y) / sqrt(@I) * sqrt(@i - 0.5) * sin(@i * 2.399963) - @y + 0.5))%) rotate(@calc(@i * 137.5078)deg) scale(@calc(0.42 * min(@X, @Y) / sqrt(@I) * 2.6 * (0.8 + 0.4 * sqrt(@i / @I)))); :before { content: ''; position: absolute; left: @match(i > I * 0.82, 30%, 15%); width: @match(i > I * 0.82, 165%, 70%); top: @match(i > I * 0.82, 32%, 20%); height: @match(i > I * 0.82, 36%, 60%); border-radius: 50%; background: @match(i > I * 0.82, @p(var(--color1), var(--color2)), @p(var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5))); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box; } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
